en.headline: September visitor arrivals reach 4.03 million, up 22 per cent
en.dek: The Tourism Board said the Mid-Autumn Festival and festive events helped push first-nine-month arrivals past 40.7 million, a 12 per cent rise.
body: Hong Kong received about 4.03 million visitor arrivals in September, a 22 per cent increase from the same month last year, the Hong Kong Tourism Board announced on Thursday.

The board said the figures were supported by the Mid-Autumn Festival holiday and local events including the Tai Hang Fire Dragon Dance, Mid-Autumn lantern carnivals and the inaugural International Lantern Spectacular. A lower comparison base caused by adverse weather last year also contributed. Mainland arrivals rose by nearly 30 per cent. Long-haul markets continued to grow, while short-haul markets faced pressure from flight capacity and fuel surcharges.

Cumulative arrivals for the first nine months of 2026 totalled about 40.7 million, up 12 per cent year on year. The board said it would continue promoting the city through upcoming events such as Hong Kong Halloween Month, the Wine and Dine Festival, WinterFest and New Year Countdown celebrations.

zh.headline: 9月訪港旅客約403萬人次按年升22% 首九個月逾4070萬
zh.dek: 旅發局指中秋假期及多項節慶活動帶動增長，內地客升近三成，全年累計升12%。
body: 香港旅遊發展局今日公佈，9月初步訪港旅客錄得約403萬人次，較去年同期上升22%。
旅發局表示，數字受惠中秋節假期及本港節慶活動，包括大坑舞火龍、中秋綵燈會及首次舉辦的國際中秋綵燈匯，加上去年同期惡劣天氣令比較基數偏低。內地訪港旅客按年升近三成。長途市場持續增長，短途市場則受航空運力及燃油附加費影響。
今年首九個月累計訪港旅客約4070萬人次，按年增加12%。旅發局將繼續透過香港萬聖月、美酒佳餚巡禮、繫紛冬日巡禮及跨年倒數等盛事推廣香港。
